description: Retrieval eval over the sample knowledge base (apps/api/seed-kb). Each question is labelled with the document that answers it and an evidence phrase copied verbatim from that document. A retrieved chunk is relevant when it comes from that document and contains the evidence (whitespace-normalised), so labels stay valid across chunk sizes. Questions deliberately mix paraphrases (favour vector search) with exact terms and numbers (favour keyword search).
status: draft - review and rewrite before quoting the numbers
